name: Lanzarote
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation covering the whole island of Lanzarote. It has four sub-zones, the largest being La Geria in the south. Its rules allow grapes such as Malvasía Volcánica and Listán Negro.
